title: SR5 / PopOut! Compatibility Fix
description:
Fixes a bug where the Shadowrun 5e (SR5-FoundryVTT) roll dialog silently opens in the main Foundry window instead of a popped-out character sheet's own window (via the PopOut! module), making dice rolls appear to stop responding once the sheet is moved to a second monitor.

This module patches SR5's TestDialog application so that PopOut! can reliably identify which actor a roll dialog belongs to, instead of relying on a timing-based guess that frequently fails.

recommends.reason: This module has no effect unless PopOut! is also installed and active.
